proposals.summary: Advances sprite sequence0 at packed signed-halfword world coordinates until completion, gates drawing on scene flags and releases the low-halfword effect-pool slot.

evidence.detail: Truncates slot to 16 bits and unpacks x/y as signed halfwords.
Advances animation each iteration even while drawing gates are set; no world-stop test is present.
Clears the pool bit after animation completion.

open_questions: Sprite descriptor is not initialized except style[5]=8; source does not establish a resource identity.

proposals.summary: If a free32-slot effect bit and0x400-byte allocation are available, initializes and starts the world sequence0 task with packed coordinates and marks the slot occupied.

evidence.detail: Searches the first clear bit among 32 pool bits, returning when full.
Allocates 0x 400 once; null returns without scheduling or setting the occupancy bit.
Initializes priority 52, task entry 69AEC and stack top allocation+0x3FC.
Passes(b<<16)|a without masking a and marks the slot after task start; no completion wait.

proposals.summary: Loads effect resource0x5008C and animates sequence1 at packed world coordinates while scene gates permit, then releases its pool slot on completion or world stop.

evidence.detail: Initializes resource 0x 5008C, loads palette 23 and remaps sprite palette entries to7/8.
Unpacks two world coordinates through fixed-point storage.
Both animation advancement and drawing occur only while three scene gates are clear.
Clears the slot bit on loop exit.

proposals.summary: Loads resource0x5008C and advances sequence14 at packed world coordinates until completion or world stop, gating drawing and releasing its pool slot.

evidence.detail: Initializes effect resource and palette.
Animation advancement occurs before draw-state gates, so it continues through gated frames.
Clears the pool slot on exit.

proposals.summary: Loads resource0x5008C and animates sequence8 following a player or enemy position, drawing on alternating pool-slot parity and releasing its slot on completion or world stop.

evidence.detail: Initializes resource and remaps palette entries7/8.
Advances animation independently of drawing gates.
Player IDs0..3 use packed snapshots; higher IDs map to enemy indexID-4 at stride 0x2E0.
Draws only when global frame parity matches pool-slot parity.
Releases pool occupancy bit on exit.

proposals.summary: Loads resource0x50074 and advances the selected low-halfword sequence following a player or enemy, then releases the pool slot packed in the first argument on completion or world stop.

evidence.detail: Initializes resource 0x 50074 and palette 23 with remapping7/8.
First argument upper halfword supplies pool bit and lower halfword supplies target actor ID.
Advances animation using arg1 low halfword before draw gates.
Targets0..3 use player snapshots; IDs4+ map to enemy slots and positions are refreshed each draw.
Releases packed pool bit on loop exit.

proposals.summary: Loads resource0x50074, plays a sequence selected by argument low byte at packed world coordinates, and releases the upper-halfword pool slot on completion or world stop.

evidence.detail: Initializes resource 0x 50074 and shared palette 23.
Second argument upper halfword selects pool bit; low byte selects animation and sound offset 0x 115.
Advances animation even while rendering gates suppress drawing.
Clears selected pool bit on exit.

proposals.summary: Loads resource0x5008C and animates sequence34 at the actor position sampled once on entry, then releases its slot on completion or world stop.

evidence.detail: Initializes resource 0x 5008C and palette 23 remapped7/8.
Samples player snapshot or enemy fixed-point coordinates before the loop.
Advances sequence 34 before rendering gates.
Clears pool bit on exit.

proposals.summary: Loads resource0x5008C and animates sequence11 following the current player or enemy position, then releases its slot on completion or world stop.

evidence.detail: Initializes resource 0x 5008C and shared palette 23 remapped7/8.
Advances sequence 11 before drawing gates.
Refreshes player/enemy position inside each permitted draw iteration.
Clears pool bit on exit.

proposals.summary: Unless world-map selection is already active, animates resource0x5008C sequence41 at packed coordinates with mode-selected drawing and releases its slot after completion or scene/world stop.

evidence.detail: World-map-active early return occurs before resource loading and bypasses final pool-bit clear.
Second argument packs draw mode in upper halfword and pool bit in lower halfword.
Stops for world-stop or map-set-zero; overlay/coordinated-attack gates suspend progression and drawing.
Advances sequence 41; mode selects map-priority draw at y+1 or descriptor draw at y.
Normal exit clears pool bit; initial world-map early return does not.

open_questions: The world-map early-return path leaves the scheduler pool bit set; no cleanup guarantee is inferred.

proposals.summary: Damages the first eligible scene object overlapping supplied fixed-point position and bounds, marks reaction state10, appends a damage record and returns1; returns0 if none.

evidence.detail: Zero object count returns0; scene object list begins at 0x 58C with stride 0x 24.
Skips states 10..12 and resource flags byte6 bits0/1.
Tests inclusive rectangular overlap using summed half extents.
Subtracts signed supplied damage into u 16 health; if stored high bit set, appends 0xFFF sentinel and clears health, otherwise appends original damage.
Sets reaction state 10 and immediately returns1.
Damage-record append silently returns when its 11-entry buffer is full; this function does not check admission.

open_questions: Damage/health ranges must avoid unintended halfword wrap; clamp tests stored bit15, not full-width subtraction sign.

proposals.summary: Damages every eligible overlapping scene object, marks reaction state10 and appends records; returns0 for an empty list, otherwise preserves input-position residue until a hit replaces it with the append helper return residue.

evidence.detail: Initializes return register to input position rather than a hit count or boolean.
Empty list returns0.
Skips states 10..12 and resource flags bit0 only, allowing bit1 objects unlike the first-hit helper.
Subtracts into halfword health; stored bit 15 causes health zero and 0xFFF record sentinel.
Result receives return from a helper whose actual source signature is void, so no meaningful success value is established.
Continues scanning after each hit, refreshing scene count; returns current residue at 1356.

open_questions: Return value is not a reliable hit count or success boolean; append helper is declared s32 locally but defined void.

proposals.summary: Computes randomized local-player attack damage for the first eligible overlapping scene object, updates its halfword health and reaction state, appends damage and returns hit presence.

evidence.detail: Empty object list returns0; states 10..12 and resource flag bits0/1 are excluded.
Inclusive summed-half-extents overlap chooses the first hit.
Uses local attack 0x 58, object defense and 100..149 percent random variance in a quadratic damage formula with minimum1.
Subtracts into u 16 health, zeroing it when bit 15 becomes set, records normalized class and requests hit audio.
Appends damage record, sets state 10 and returns1; no-hit path returns0.

open_questions: Power+defense denominator is not guarded against zero; record-buffer admission is not checked.

proposals.summary: Computes randomized enemy-versus-player damage with critical and elemental resistance scaling, returning a critical marker outside encounter mode and issuing hit audio inside it.

evidence.detail: Looks up enemy attack resource via key 0x 22C and reads player defense 0x5A.
Critical roll selects divisor 100 and world critical sprite; ordinary hit uses 200.
Quadratic randomized damage helper truncates to u 16 and ensures a minimum1 before element scaling.
Element1..7 selects six resistance slots; signed resistance is squared in 5000/(r*r+2500), then halfword high-bit and nonpositive-result checks enforce minimum1.
Encounter mode plays critical/class-hit audio and returns unmarked halfword damage; otherwise critical result is ORed with 0x 8000.
Enemy-contact caller consumes the high bit as critical and strips it before pending-health accumulation.

open_questions: Attack+defense division is unguarded for zero; no hit/team eligibility is checked in this calculator.

proposals.summary: For effect kinds1/4, computes a resistance-and-level chance, scales magnitude and enqueues a status record; a local target outside player-battle rules also gains resistance feedback and a status marker.

evidence.detail: Kinds1/4 use resistance indices0/3 and distinct probability divisors 25/50; all other kinds return.
Applies signed player modifier for local target or player-battle-rules player targets.
Writes packet kind only on successful chance; failure leaves preexisting stack bits rather than explicitly clearing kind.
Reads packet kind1/4 to choose 450..549 or 700..799 magnitude factor; other byte values return.
Enemy type3 returns; packet uses mapped actor ID and u 16 magnitude.
Calls status-record enqueue without checking success; a local target outside player-battle rules also invokes resistance feedback and writes the status marker.

open_questions: Failed probability test leaves packet-kind bits uninitialized in the matching C; no guaranteed failed-roll no-op is claimed.
No team or full target-domain validation exists here; target IDs must be valid.

proposals.summary: Calculates player-versus-enemy damage from attack state, class/skill scaling, critical variance, defense and eligible elemental resistance, with selected linked-skill and audiovisual side effects.

evidence.detail: Normal critical roll uses divisor 100 or 200 and sound/sprite feedback; nonzero noCrit uses divisor 1000 with no critical roll.
Charged state5 selects class/action-specific power formulas; otherwise flag 0x 200000 selects magic-scaled power and default uses base attack.
Uses randomized quadratic damage against enemy defense 0x1CE.
Only valid selected equipment applies attack element against enemy resistance array 0x 218; clamps truncated nonpositive result to1 at this stage.
Class0 target-state2 bonus and class3 linked-effect enqueue are conditional on saved skills.
Class7 nearby-facing bonus uses signed directional difference and returns final u 16 result without a universal final clamp.
Enemy hit application consumes this calculator.

open_questions: Attack+defense and magic-stat denominators are unguarded for pathological inputs; target validity/team/duplicate-hit filtering is caller responsibility.

proposals.summary: Calculates player-versus-player damage with class/attack scaling, critical variance and player resistance, adds the state5 percentage bonus, then returns the signed-quarter result as a halfword with zero changed to1.

evidence.detail: Critical roll and feedback choose divisor 100/200; nonzero noCrit selects 1000.
Charged and magic-flag power branches mirror the enemy-target calculator.
Valid equipment element uses player resistance array 0x7C with intermediate minimum1.
State5 applies a 10 percent bonus before later class bonuses.
Class3 can enqueue linked effect and class7 compares target packed facing for directional bonus.
Casts damage to s 16 before division by4, casts quotient to u 16, and changes only zero to1; a universal positive clamp is not present.
Player-on-player hit application consumes this calculator.

open_questions: No team/death/duplicate-hit filtering exists inside the calculator; caller must supply valid combat targets and denominator domains.

proposals.summary: Builds a player-target hit packet, applies signed source health/energy recovery with upper caps, records hit history and enqueues or merges the packet; target health is applied by the receiver.

evidence.detail: Flags bit0 selects divisor 1000 damage OR 0x 8000 and zero impulse/direction; ordinary path computes direction and kind8 charged-attack scaling.
Rolls target status kind from player resistances and attack element.
Adds damage-derived signed source health and energy recovery; caps only above maxima, with halfword truncation.
Stores source attack sequence into target history before link enqueue.
Calls EnqueueOrMergeLinkHit without queue-capacity guard or checking its result.
Hit queue merges only pending tag 0x8A with same target byte; adds u 16 damage and overwrites direction/impulse, otherwise appends.
Receiver applies pending player damage and knockback for local target; this producer does not mutate target health.
Contact caller checks distinct nonzero teams>2 and target states before invoking player-hit helper.

open_questions: Queue-full failure does not roll back source recovery/history writes; enqueue/merge does not guarantee delivery.
Target/source bounds and team eligibility are caller preconditions, not enforced here.

proposals.summary: Unless the link queue is full, calculates and applies pending enemy damage/status/knockback and source recovery, records hit credit and enqueues or merges a hit notification with optional class effects.

evidence.detail: Full link queue returns before mutation, even if a same-target message could otherwise merge.
Flags bit0 selects reduced divisor 1000 damage with 0x 8000 marker and zero impulse/direction; normal path sets reaction state 10.
Impulse combines attack/source modifier minus enemy resistance, clearing on bit7 or resistance 0xFF; normal path applies charged/type/class bonuses.
Normal path applies signed source recovery and upper health/energy caps; flags-bit0 path skips this recovery block.
Rolls/initializes status records and optional effect presentation.
Marks local-player hit-credit bit, writes source sequence, accumulates damage masked 0x7FFF and stores display damage.
Resets enemy animation state except enemy type3, applies knockback and enqueues hit without checking result.
Class5 may enqueue effect6; class2 chance success may enqueue critical marker.
Notification queue can merge pending same-target tag 0x8A; this is queue admission, not delivery.
Upstream player-contact loop rejects same-team/zero-team actors and duplicate hit sequences before invoking this helper.

open_questions: No source/target team or active-state validation inside this application helper; upstream callers own those filters.
Packet/health arithmetic truncates to halfwords and no rollback is performed after later notification admission failures.
